Benevolent but overwhelming, no mane, thick canine neck, wolf body or snarling fangs or cruelty.

MOOD: overwhelming and imposing sacred presence; respectful, benevolent when source says so, energetic and majestic, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: one square original illustration; no text, labels, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra limbs, heads, tails or digits beyond exact counts above; no nudity or gore; no design from a film, game, anime or comic; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or unsupported supernatural effects. CRITICAL SOURCE CORRECTION: Each foot must be an UNDIVIDED HORSE HOOF, not the CLOVEN paired toes of a deer, cow or goat. Make the body slender roe-deer anatomy and the forehead wolf-like while retaining a narrow deer-shaped muzzle. NO animal mane.
